== List of items ==
The following are items that can be purchased, sold, transferred to and from planets, and carried in a ships inventory. All values are default values.

=== Men ===
[[MBMGEMSG.MSG#Item weight|Weight]]: 1 ton

[[MBMGEMSG.MSG#Planet item production rate|Production rate]]: 3500

[[MBMGEMSG.MSG#Base prices|Base price]]: 2

Purpose: Men create items, pay taxes, and add to the score of the user who owns their planet.

More information: [[Colonizing planets]]

=== Missiles ===
Weight: 5 tons

Production rate: 300

Base price: 20

Purpose: Ship-to-ship combat.

More information: [[Weapons and combat#Missiles]]

=== Torpedoes ===
Weight: 3 tons

Production rate: 500

Base price: 7

Purpose: Ship-to-ship combat.

More information: [[Weapons and combat#Torpedoes]]

=== Ion cannons ===
Weight: 250 tons

Production rate: 4

Base price: 33

Purpose: Planetary defense.

More information: [[Colonizing planets#Ion cannons]]

=== Flux pods ===
Weight: 20 tons

Production rate: 200

Base price: 200

Purpose: Powering ships.

More information: [[Neutron flux]]

=== Food cases ===
Weight: 2 tons

Production rate: 8000

Base price: 2

Purpose: Sustenance for men and troops on a planet.

More information: [[Colonizing planets]]

=== Fighters ===
Weight: 15 tons

Production rate: 100

Base price: 50

Purpose: Planetary defense and attack.

More information: [[Colonizing planets#Fighters]] and [[Attacking planets]]

=== Decoys ===
Weight: 3 tons

Production rate: 900

Base price: 18

Purpose: Defense in ship-to-ship combat, reduces chance of being hit by torpedoes and missiles.

More information: [[Defensive systems#Decoy]]

=== Troops ===
Weight: 2 tons

Production rate: 200

Base price: 1

Purpose: Planetary defense and attack.

More information: [[Colonizing planets#Troops]] and [[Attacking planets]]

=== Zippers ===
Weight: 5 tons

Production rate: 100

Base price: 99

Purpose: Triggers mines.

More information: [[Weapons and combat#Zippers]]

=== Jammers ===
Weight: 4 tons

Production rate: 300

Base price: 21

Purpose: Jams scanners of ships in the area.

More information: [[Weapons and combat#Jammers]]

=== Mines ===
Weight: 5 tons

Production rate: 500

Base price:16

Purpose: Ship-to-ship combat.

More information: [[Weapons and combat#Mines]]

=== Gold ===
Weight: 0.5 tons

Production rate: 30

Base price: 100

Purpose: Sell for cash, increase planetary production.

More information: (TO DO)

=== Spies ===
Weight: 1 ton

Production rate: 20

Base price: 100

Purpose: Find out information about other planets.

More information: [[Attacking planets#Spies]]
